mapper.select: SELECT c.card_id AS cardId, c.card_company_id AS cardCompanyId, cc.company_name AS companyName, c.card_name AS cardName, c.card_type AS cardType, c.image_url AS imageUrl, c.description AS description FROM card c INNER JOIN card_company cc ON cc.card_company_id = c.card_company_id WHERE c.card_company_id = #{cardCompanyId} AND c.is_active = 'Y' AND cc.is_active = 'Y' ORDER BY c.card_name ASC

SELECT c.card_id AS cardId, c.card_company_id AS cardCompanyId, cc.company_name AS companyName, c.card_name AS cardName, c.card_type AS cardType, c.image_url AS imageUrl, c.description AS description FROM card c INNER JOIN card_company cc ON cc.card_company_id = c.card_company_id WHERE c.card_id = #{cardId} AND c.is_active = 'Y' AND cc.is_active = 'Y' LIMIT 1
